name: Imouto de Ikou!
source:
Hisashi Yoshizumi lost his mother at a very young age, and has always lived with his father. One day after arriving from school, he finds out that he has a new mother and sister! A heartwarming family comedy ensues.

[from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A6%B9%E3%81%A7%E3%81%84%E3%81%93%E3%81%86!]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
吉住久志年幼时失去母亲，此后一直与父亲共同生活。一天放学回家，他发现自己竟然多了一位新妈妈和一个妹妹！一场温馨的家庭喜剧就此开始。

[摘自[url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A6%B9%E3%81%A7%E3%81%84%E3%81%93%E3%81%86!]Wikipedia[/url]]
